note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published via Exophase and carried in full by the guides cited below. Every guide is written in our own words for this entry; a source is cited, never copied.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat the roadmap below as the route to it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story chapters unlock in order, so this pops when the chapter ends. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This is also when both Lucia and Jason become playable, which opens most of the list — several trophies need the two of them together.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The robbery trophies open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so start those once this chapter ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Save manually before it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a pre-finale save is your safety net for anything tied to the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Breakfast Run mission. It is a story mission, so it unlocks as you play through the chapters.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist. A story heist mission — it unlocks when the mission is complete.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play mission. Story mission — it pops on completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission. Story mission — it pops on completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Story mission — it pops on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. Story mission — it pops on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's internal tracker — a 35-task checklist covering story, side missions, collectibles and activities. It is the biggest single grind and the last Gold before the Platinum, so leave it for the cleanup stage and let the other trophies fill the checklist as you go.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime the game counts in its Stats. Build the count across free roam rather than hunting one spot; the total is tracked, so check Stats to see how far along you are.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them, just sample each one, so sweep through the activity list in free roam.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's challenge list and replay any you miss — gold is a score bar, not a one-time event, so you can retry each challenge until it clicks.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every drone-race location. Win one race at each spot on the map — the locations are the race venues themselves, so visit them all.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race event counts once, so enter a spread of events rather than replaying one favourite — variety is the requirement.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the fishing challenge against Cal and out-fish him — it is a head-to-head fishing event, not a free-roam catch count.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk up to an arcade cabinet and finish a game — any title counts, and finishing (not winning) is the trigger.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Andy is one of the stranger strands — follow his missions to their end.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are the side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others) — finish any 8 of them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts and disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay — meditate on the balcony during Chapter 1, then find the remaining spots across the map. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand asks for a specific animal — track it where Bret points you and take it down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — collect full sets, three of them, and the trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone and network feature — trigger it at 100 different spots across the map; the count is tracked, so it builds up as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — finish any 50 across the map and the counter fills.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose the cops. Do it in free roam with Lucia or Jason alongside — get the heat up to four stars, then break line of sight and escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row while the wanted stars stay up — plan a route between nearby shops and keep moving.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — the game logs each new one, so variety (not repeats) is what counts.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight with a group, then drop five enemies before it ends — pick a crowded fight so the targets are there.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Take off from the airport without a scheduled flight — steal a plane and get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank — the description is a joke about how hot it gets in one. Find a Rhino (military areas and the airport are the usual places) and climb in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so save first and treat it as a one-clean-run job.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies open in the later chapters — hit five vaults and get away clean each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck in free roam, take the cash and lose the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the state — the map fills in as you travel, and the trophy pops when the last area is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations — hit one per gang across Leonida.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. No confirmed unlock method has been published at launch — the description itself is the guide: a drink, a view, Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom's front and out the other side. No confirmed unlock method has been published at launch — the description is the guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through on a full game. Head to the alley and play through.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a feat you pull off together with your partner that draws a crowd. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the description; it is tied to the Lucia-and-Jason partnership, so look for a shared public moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice — the trophy pops when a decision you make lands, for better or worse. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save before big story decisions.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — retry something and get it right on the second attempt. No confirmed unlock method has been published at launch; the description points to a do-over moment.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A strange, unexplained moment — the description is deliberately cryptic. It reads like a one-off encounter or easter egg; no confirmed unlock method has been published at launch.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock targets down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. No confirmed unlock method has been published at launch; the description is the guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total is tracked until $250,000 is washed.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, gear and more — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so it fills naturally as you play and shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the market — they are the properties that store your vehicle collection.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register ten different vehicles you own or find.
